control_objective: Access for terminated personnel is revoked from financially-significant systems within the defined service-level agreement so that no former employee retains the ability to transact.
risk_addressed: Active accounts for terminated staff provide an unmonitored path to initiate unauthorized transactions or exfiltrate data, defeating the control environment and misstating the financial statements.

required_data_elements.business_definition: A recorded employee termination with an effective date from the HR feed.
The current enabled/disabled state and last revocation timestamp of a user's access on in-scope systems.

method.summary: Reconcile HR terminations to IAM revocations and confirm every leaver was de-provisioned within SLA with no accounts left open.
steps: Pull the population of terminations effective in the period from the HR feed.
Pull account status and revocation timestamps for those identities from Identity Governance.
Compute the percentage of leavers whose access was revoked within the defined SLA.
Count accounts still active for terminated staff (open leaver accounts).
Flag any leaver not revoked within SLA or any account still open.
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any active account for a terminated user, or any revocation outside SLA, is a control exception.
thresholds.pass_tolerance: 100% revoked within SLA, 0 open leaver accounts
thresholds.warning_threshold: Revocation within SLA below 100% with no account still open

pass_criteria: No active accounts remain for terminated staff.
fail_criteria: One or more leavers not de-provisioned within SLA.
One or more accounts remain active for terminated staff.
exception_handling: Immediately revoke any open account and re-test before relying on the control.

assertions.description: No active accounts for terminated staff.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §302 certification.

actions_on_fail: Notify Access Administrator and IT Security Manager
